Players Committee card image of [[F-11D Blaster Rifle (Errata)|F-11D Blaster Rifle (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Deploy on your First Order warrior. May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 if fired by a stormtrooper. Target hit, and may not be used to satisfy attrition, if total destiny > defense value.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/f11dblasterrifle.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/fdfe14b7f81967a10e659a872abdeebecd8c5a25 fdfe14b] (12 July 2020). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
